title: Darkest Depths
description: Adds a New Dark Dimension to your World
body:
Darkest Depths is a Mod that Focuses on the "Ancient Portal" idea



<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

> New Dimension! The Abyss is a new Dimension of this Mod, to Enter, You Need a New item Called the Souls of the Abyss Found in Ancient City Loot and use it!

</details>




<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

> New Biomes! there are 3 New Biomes, the Abyssal Caverns ,the Sarkha Forest, and the Forgotten Dune's! The Abyssal Caverns is Just a Abyss's Version of the Nether Wastes But the Sarkha Forest  & the Forgotten Dune's on the Other Hand is WAY more Exiting.


</details>



<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

> New Mobs! The Stalker Which Gets Angered when You Trigger a Sculk Sensor, The Snapper Which Hides in Sculk, the Hollowed Which Only Attacks Until you Step on a Hollow Radar, The Spitter that Spits Poison Bubble's, and The New Boss: The Twisted Warden!

</details>




<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

> New Tool/Armor Set! Cartilage can be Used to Craft a New Armor/Tool Set that is between Iron and Diamond! or You Can make a NEW block that Replenish's Your Hunger!

</details>




<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

> New Structure's! the Ancient Temple, Filled with Loot But With MANY Shriekers, The Abyss Portal Statue, A Simple Portal Back Home! and the Forgotten Ruins, A Ruin With 1 Chest!

</details>



> And Miscellaneous Features! 

there are Other Features added To This Mod so Download and Play!
